headline: Brazil Court Blocks Casas Bahia From Transferring $5.5 Million Out of BRB
summary: A court in Brasília denied retailer Casas Bahia's request to transfer about $5.5 million in court deposits out of state-owned bank BRB, citing a lack of proven risk.
why: Casas Bahia is one of Brazil's largest non-food retail chains, and court decisions on liquidity management reflect financial and operational constraints.

impacts.name: Casas Bahia
impacts.why: The court refused the retailer's petition to move $5.5 million out of court deposits.
